item.title: [7.2] S3AC: Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic for LLM Reasoning
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Critic-free methods are widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, avoiding difficult and costly critic training. Common alternatives lack token-level credit assignment and typically rely on grouped rollouts to estimate prompt-specific baselines. A critic can address both limitations, but long-CoT critic training is hindered...

WHY IT MATTERS

S3AC offers a substantive methodological fix for long-CoT reinforcement learning by successfully reintroducing a critic model to provide token-level credit assignment without destabilizing training.

item.description:

Our analysis reveals that this uniformity inherently reinforces structurally unreasonable actions in...
